title: It's the AI way or the highway = perma-banned on Unity discord (lol)
author: FaustInTranslation
selftext:
That's a legitimate exchange there from the Unity discord (blanking out certain names).

I even praised Unity over Unreal - I just said, and I believe rightly so, that you need AI to create custom tools within Unity to make a modicum of sense of what is going on in that 'app'.

Permanently banned for it (lmfao)... 

You can't even moderately joke about AI on these channels, even when you're trying to improve the underlying engine...

I've spent the last year using AI to iterate, recreate, and asset-manage THE SAME intro battle area within Unity, and making an entire 'game mechanics' studio, and 'random map generator' within Unity. I've AI behaviour graphs looking like something from a map of a Paris underground tunnel system.

I can launch tests of any AI behaviour/scenario with any combination of factors - THANKS TO AI.

The intro combat is 100% random now, infinitely scalable, and I've tested and tested - and I still won't release anything until I've another 2 months (at least) of testing done...

Yeah, you can abuse AI - sure. 'I did this in 2 hours with Claude' - and it's some copy of whatever.

But my entire 1 year with AI is: tools, tools, balance, tools, tools, testing, tools, tools...

There's no 'gen-AI' with what I'm talking about. I'm hand-drawing the assets - well, look, they're not Picasso but they're not AI either... 

But I'm a dev for 9-5 and use AI nonstop in 'regular' dev land. For game dev, I'm 100% focused on AI behaviours (enemies), completely weird systems (in a good way!) and balance/testing tools...

Anyway rant over.

Unity discords sucks ass, is the TLDR. I mean, you can't even say 'AI made me an email' in that place - clearly - because you'll be perma-banned.
